description: Windows desktop video downloader. Paste a link from almost any site; also serves the Astra Deck browser extension over a local API.
notes: This package installs the portable one-folder layout, so Astra Downloader keeps its state beside the executable rather than in %LOCALAPPDATA%. Everything below is persisted, so an update keeps your settings, history, queue, subscriptions and stored sign-ins.
yt-dlp, FFmpeg and a JavaScript runtime are fetched and checksum-verified on first run, then persisted so an update does not download them again.
Stored sign-ins live in site-logins. 'scoop uninstall -p astra-downloader' removes them along with the rest of the state.
